title: Second tank beside the first
prompt: Stage 3-1, level 5. You bought a second frontliner. Your 3-cost tank is already in the centre of the front row. Place the 2-cost tank.
explanation:
Two frontliners standing next to each other share the enemy's attention: whoever the enemy targets, the other one keeps fighting and the pair blocks the path to the backline. Put the second tank directly beside the first, on column 2 or 4.

A tank in a far corner fights alone against whichever enemy walks to it and leaves a hole in the middle of the line. Row 1 behind the first tank is also wrong: it does not block anything until the first tank dies.
principle: A frontline is a line. Fill the hex next to your tank before you fill any other hex.
commonMistake: Spreading tanks across the front row, one per corner, so each one takes a whole enemy side alone.
